Interesting! Look at `bin_mach0.c` lines 44 and 60 - they both call `sdb_ns_set(sdb, "info", res->kv)` with the same `sdb` and the same `res->kv`. This means the same Sdb (`res->kv`) is set as a namespace under the same name ("info") in the same parent Sdb (`sdb`). But `sdb_ns_set` checks by hash - if the same name is used, it replaces the old entry. So this doesn't create two entries.
